effect: Patients with the TT or CT genotype and cancer who are treated with a fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy or tagafur, may have increased risk and increased severity of drug toxicity as compared to patients with the CC genotype.
recommendation: Determine DPD activity. For patients with a DPD activity score of 0, an alternative drug is recommended. For patients with a score of 1 or 1.5, start with 50% of the standard dose or use an alternative drug. Adjust subsequent doses based on toxicity. Avoid tegafur or start with a low dose and adjust the initial dose based on toxicity and efficacy.

effect: Patients with the TT or CT genotype may have decreased dose of mercaptopurine as compared to patients with the CC genotype
recommendation: Consider an alternate drug or extreme dose reduction of mercaptopurine for patients who are TPMT or NUDT15 poor metabolizers. Start at 30-80% of target dose for patients who are intermediate metabolizers of either TPMT or NUDT15 and start at 20-50% of target dose for a intermediate metabolizers of both TPMT and NUDT15.
